task.description:
ADHOC — start backend services required by TEST-RUNNER. Both http://localhost:8081/health/ready (Keycloak) and http://localhost:8080/health/ready (bpm-platform API) are currently DOWN. Test DB on localhost:5433 is UP.

Tasks:
  1. docker-compose up -d db db_test keycloak bpm-platform
  2. Wait until `docker-compose ps` shows all services 'healthy' (poll every 5s, max 120s).
  3. Verify Keycloak: GET http://localhost:8081/health/ready returns 200.
  4. Verify bpm-platform API: GET http://localhost:8080/health/ready returns 200.
  5. Verify test DB: psql $BPM_TEST_DB_URL -c 'SELECT 1' returns 1 row.
  6. Run `zig build migrate` to apply any pending migrations (BPM_DB_URL may differ from BPM_TEST_DB_URL — use BPM_DB_URL for production-target DB).

Return PASS only when all four services respond and zig build migrate exits 0.

Do NOT modify any source files. Do NOT commit anything. This is pure infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: docker-compose ps shows all services healthy

result.summary: db, db_test, keycloak, and keycloak_gateway are healthy; Keycloak HTTP 200 (exit 0); bpm-platform API HTTP 200 (exit 0); test DB SELECT 1 returned one row (exit 0); migrations completed with exit 0. The compose project has no bpm-platform service, so the API was started directly with the repository environment.
